calc.paint.howItWorksDesc: To estimate paint, you calculate the total surface area of the walls, subtract the areas that won't be painted (doors and windows), and divide by the paint's coverage rate.
calc.paint.exampleDesc: Painting a room with 40 m² of walls, 1 door (2 m²), and 1 window (1.5 m²):
calc.paint.tipsDesc: Doors and windows take up significant wall space. A standard interior door is about 2 m² (21 sq ft) and a standard window is about 1.5 m² (15 sq ft). Subtracting them prevents you from over-buying paint.
calc.paint.disclaimer: Textured walls, bare drywall, and dramatic color changes (e.g., painting white over dark blue) will require more paint or a primer coat.
calc.gravel.disclaimer: Always verify with your local supplier as moisture and exact rock composition can change the final weight significantly.
calc.gravel.howItWorksDesc: Estimating gravel, crushed stone, or soil usually involves finding the volume in cubic yards or cubic meters, and then converting that volume into weight (tons) since most bulk materials are sold by weight.
calc.gravel.tipsDesc: Different materials have different densities. Standard gravel is usually around 1.6 metric tons per cubic meter. Soil is lighter (around 1.2 t/m³), while sand is heavier. Check with your supplier for the exact conversion factor.
calc.area.howItWorksDesc: Square footage (or square meters) is the most basic and common measurement in home improvement. It measures the 2D area of a surface, like a floor, wall, or garden bed.
calc.area.exampleDesc: Measuring a rectangular room that is 4 meters long and 3 meters wide:
calc.area.tipsDesc: If your room isn't a perfect rectangle (like an L-shaped room), break it down into smaller rectangular sections. Measure the area of each section separately, then add them together for the total area.
calc.area.disclaimer: Always measure twice! For expensive materials like hardwood flooring or custom tiles, add a 5-10% waste factor to your final area calculation.
static.about.title: About
static.about.p1: Home Project Calculator is a collection of simple tools designed to help homeowners, DIYers, and project planners estimate quantities, measurements, and material requirements.
static.about.p2: We believe that planning a project shouldn't require complex spreadsheets or paid software. Our tools are built to be accessible, completely free, and incredibly fast.
static.about.f2: Calculations run instantly in your browser.
static.about.f3: Full support for both Metric and Imperial units.
static.about.f5: Ability to enter your own local material prices for accurate cost estimates.
static.about.disclaimer: Please note that all tools provide estimates for planning purposes. Always consult professional advice for structural, safety, or load-bearing projects.
static.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
static.privacy.p1: At Home Project Calculator, your privacy is a priority. We have designed our tools to work entirely within your web browser.
static.privacy.dataDesc: We do not require you to create an account, and we do not collect personal identifiable information (PII) during your use of our calculators.
static.privacy.localDesc: To provide a better user experience, we save your basic preferences (such as preferred Language, Country, Currency, and Unit System) in your browser's Local Storage. This data never leaves your device and is not sent to our servers.
static.privacy.analyticsDesc: We reserve the right to implement anonymous traffic analytics (such as page views) in the future to help us improve the website. Any such implementation will respect standard Do Not Track (DNT) requests.
static.terms.title: Terms of Service
static.terms.p1: By accessing and using Home Project Calculator, you agree to these Terms of Service.
static.terms.useDesc: The calculators provided on this website are free tools intended for general planning and estimation. You may use them for personal or professional planning purposes.
static.terms.estimatesDesc: All calculations generated by this website are estimates. While we strive for mathematical accuracy, we cannot guarantee that the results will exactly match your real-world requirements due to variations in materials, waste, site conditions, and manufacturer specifications.
static.terms.userDesc: You are solely responsible for verifying the accuracy of measurements and quantities before purchasing materials or beginning construction. Home Project Calculator is not liable for material shortages, overages, financial losses, or structural defects resulting from the use of these tools.
static.disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
static.disclaimer.p1: Calculations provided by Home Project Calculator are estimates intended for preliminary planning purposes only.
static.disclaimer.d1: Product Coverage Varies: Paint coverage, tile breakage, and material yields vary significantly by manufacturer and environmental conditions.
static.disclaimer.d2: Material Density: Aggregate materials like gravel or soil can vary in weight depending on composition and moisture content.
static.disclaimer.d3: Verify Measurements: Always double-check your site measurements before purchasing materials.
static.disclaimer.d4: Professional Advice: For projects involving structural integrity, safety, electrical, or plumbing systems, always consult a licensed professional or structural engineer.
static.contact.title: Contact
static.contact.p1: Have a question, a suggestion for a new calculator, or found an issue with an existing tool?
static.hiw.title: How It Works
static.hiw.p1: Using Home Project Calculator is designed to be as straightforward as possible.
static.hiw.steps.1.d: Navigate to our Calculators or Projects section to find the tool that matches your task.
static.hiw.steps.2.d: Use the gear icon in the header to select your preferred unit system (Metric or Imperial) and currency.
static.hiw.steps.3.d: Input the dimensions of your project space. The calculator updates instantly.
static.hiw.steps.4.d: Modify the waste factor and price per unit to get a realistic estimate before you head to the store.
